items.title: Annie Ross — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I walked up to the guitar player... I said, 'What’s your name?' He said, 'Django Reinhardt.'

ctx.x: Did you ever perform with Mary Lou? Or did you ever get a chance to sing for her?

Yeah, in Paris. Oh yeah. We found a place that was a restaurant. Downstairs they had a bar, a room that they didn’t use anymore, but it had a piano. We used to go there. The waiters knew us all. We would congregate in this room, sometimes just a pianist and myself. That was wonderful. My ears were wide open. Oh, and I want to tell you about when I was in Paris and Klook and me had a band. It was Don Byas. It was full of wonderful musicians. When I first arrived in Paris, I was all of what? – 17 or 18. Someone…
When you described this guitarist, it had to be Django.
